headline: Fishermen Rescue Exhausted Kangaroo Found 3km Out to Sea
meta_description: Port Lincoln fishermen discovered a exhausted kangaroo swimming 3km offshore and brought it safely back to the beach.
summary_short: Port Lincoln fishermen found an exhausted kangaroo 3km out to sea off South Australia, cradled it aboard, and watched it rest before hopping away.
body:
Port Lincoln fishermen discovered an exhausted kangaroo struggling 3 kilometers out to sea off South Australia's coast. The animal had somehow ventured far from land, and without the fishermen's intervention, its survival would have been uncertain.

Once aboard, the crew cradled the exhausted marsupial during the journey back to shore. The careful handling allowed the kangaroo to rest and recover from its ordeal in the water.

When they reached the beach, the animal found solid ground beneath its feet once more. After resting on the sand, the kangaroo regained enough strength to hop away, disappearing back into its natural habitat—a small but heartening reminder that sometimes human compassion and quick thinking make all the difference in a creature's survival.
quick_facts: Kangaroo found 3km offshore near Port Lincoln, South Australia
Local fishermen rescued the exhausted animal
Crew cradled kangaroo during return to shore
Animal rested on beach before hopping away
